# Vendored headers

Downloaded 2026-10-11 for this prototype:

- NppPluginInterfaceMac.h: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextpad-plus-plus/nextpad-plus-plus-macos/main/src/NppPluginInterfaceMac.h
- Nextpad-LICENSE.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextpad-plus-plus/nextpad-plus-plus-macos/main/LICENSE
- Scintilla.h: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mirror/scintilla/master/include/Scintilla.h
- Sci_Position.h: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mirror/scintilla/master/include/Sci_Position.h
- Scintilla-LICENSE.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mirror/scintilla/master/License.txt

Headers are vendored, so builds do not fetch changing upstream branches. Checksums
are recorded in SHA256SUMS. Full upstream licenses are retained alongside them.
